children: Ayala Corp.'s 2H earnings are likely to be stronger, Maybank Securities' Ronalyn Joyce Lalimo says in a research report. Drivers include real-estate subsidiary Ayala Land's residential inventory normalization and leasing growth, and energy subsidiary ACEN Corp.'s higher renewable generation and new capacity contributions, the analyst says. The Philippine conglomerate's emerging businesses have also continued to improve operationally, with subsidiary AC Logistics narrowing net losses and turning EBIT-positive, the analyst adds. The brokerage raises the stock's target price to 680.00 pesos from 670.00 pesos to reflect a valuation roll-forward, with an unchanged buy rating. Shares are 0.2% higher at 494.80 pesos. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
